name: gaps2-ceasefire
description: Ceasefire (audit-gaps-2, off switch TI4_RULES_AGENDAS / rulesGateAgendas). Card text: 'After the [color] player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your units: The [color] player cannot move units to the active system. Then return this card to the [color] player.' pbd28@54: Yssaril (holding Deepwrought's Ceasefire, 1 destroyer in 209) — Deepwrought activates 209, Yssaril plays the Ceasefire, Deepwrought's move of a carrier from 313 into 209 is refused (original: moved). The engine /move and the legacy unitTacticalMove_ / concludeMove_ are refused alike.
